name: a2ui-renderer
title_zh: 让 CopilotKit 自动渲染 Agent 声明
tagline_zh: Agent 说我要一个表单，你还在手写 renderActivityMessages？装上它。
tagline_en: Stop hand-wiring renderActivityMessages. This skill auto-renders Agent-declared A2UI surfaces via /info, with.
desc_en: Render A2UI (Agent-to-UI declarative surfaces) in CopilotKit v2. Enable the runtime via CopilotRuntime({ a2ui: {...} }), then enable the provider via <CopilotKit a2ui={{ theme }}>. Auto-activates via /info — do NOT manually pass renderActivityMessages. createA2UIMessageRenderer ships from @copilotkit/react-core/v2; low-level primitives (A2UIProvider, A2UIRenderer, createCatalog) ship from @copilot
why_zh: 它把 A2UI 的运行时与 Provider 两处开关一次配齐，并拦截 /info 自动激活。
why_en: Wires both runtime and provider flags in one pass, auto-activates via /info, and skips manual message plumbing—without touching.
limit_zh: 只认 CopilotKit v2 的 A2UI 协议；若你的 Agent 返回非声明式 payload（如纯 mark。
limit_en: Only handles CopilotKit v2 A2UI payloads; non-declarative outputs (e.g., markdown) won't render. Requires both runtime and provider a2ui flags.
